input: Search the web for "youth enrichment" summer programs for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell and McDowell counties, NC (Marshall, Mars Hill, Burnsville, Marion). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.
searches: youth enrichment summer programs Madison County NC 2025

candidates.name: Madison County 4-H / N.C. Cooperative Extension
candidates.note: 2025 Summer Fun educational day camps for ages 5–18, including agriculture, science, cooking and outdoor activities.

candidates.name: Madison County Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: Summer recreation program with registration materials and trip schedules for 2025 and 2026.

candidates.name: Madison County Arts Council
candidates.note: First Stage Youth Theatre summer day camp ran July 28–August 1, 2025, for ages 8 and up.

candidates.name: Glory Ridge
candidates.note: Weeklong summer youth-group mission programs combine home-repair service, worship and outdoor activities; a 2026 week was advertised.

candidates.name: Yancey County 4-H / N.C. Cooperative Extension
candidates.note: 2025 Exploring Ag Camp included animal farming, vegetable harvesting, cooking and farm visits.

candidates.name: Yancey County Schools
candidates.note: Free 2025 CTE summer camps explored careers for students entering grades 7–10.

candidates.name: Mitchell County 4-H / N.C. Cooperative Extension
candidates.note: 2026 4-H Summer Fun offered youth camps through the Mitchell County Extension center.

candidates.name: McDowell County 4-H / N.C. Cooperative Extension
